parts.name: ScaleOptions
parts.description: The value of the `xScale` and `yScale` props of `Chart.Root`.

props.name: type
props.description:
The type of scale: `scaleLinear` (the default), `scaleTime` or `scaleBand`. Import the type
from its subpath, thus a chart includes only the scales that it uses.

props.name: domain
props.description: The values at the two ends. Without it, the root uses the smallest and the largest value.

props.name: nice
props.description: Extends the domain to round values. The default is the same as for `zero`.

props.name: zero
props.description:
Extends the domain to include zero. A bar starts at zero, thus a bar chart needs it. The
default is `true` for the value axis of a chart with categories on the other axis, and for y
when no axis has categories.

props.name: padding
props.description: The space between two bands of a band scale, as a fraction of a step. The default is 0.2.

parts.name: Scale
parts.description: The function that a scale type makes. It maps a value to a position in pixels.

props.name: kind
props.description: The name of the type of scale.

props.name: domain
props.description: The values at the two ends of the scale.

props.name: range
props.description: The positions, in pixels, of the two ends of the scale.

props.name: bandwidth
props.description:
The width of one band, in pixels, for a band scale. The scale gives the middle of the band.
It is 0 for a continuous scale.

props.name: invert
props.description: The position back to a value.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Round values in the domain, about `count` of them.

props.name: tickFormat
props.description: The function that writes the labels of the ticks that `ticks(count)` gives.

props.name: valueFormat
props.type: (values: number[], locale?: string, options?: FormatOptions) => (value: number) => string
props.description:
The function that writes a value in full, for the names of the points and the data table.
`values` are all of the values of the channel. Without `options`, a time scale chooses the
precision from them.

props.name: nice
props.description: The domain, extended to round values.
